title: Integer multiplicity slices from the co-area structure: mass bound, integrability and the averaged slice identity (Simon Ch. 6, 4.1–4.5(1), 4.2)
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (RT : IMRep U (n + 1)) (f : Euclid P → ℝ) (L : NNReal) (g : Euclid P → Euclid P), IsOpen U → LipschitzWith L f → Measurable g → (∀ x, ‖g x‖ ≤ L) → (∀ᵐ x ∂(μHE[n + 1].restrict RT.carrier), g x ∈ approxTangentPlane (n + 1) RT.carrier x) → (∀ φ : Euclid P → ℝ≥0∞, Measurable φ → AEMeasurable (fun t => ∫⁻ x in RT.carrier ∩ {x | g x ≠ 0} ∩ f ⁻¹' {t}, φ x ∂μHE[n]) ∧ ∫⁻ t, (∫⁻ x in RT.carrier ∩ {x | g x ≠ 0} ∩ f ⁻¹' {t}, φ x ∂μHE[n]) = ∫⁻ x in RT.carrier, ‖g x‖ₑ * φ x ∂μHE[n + 1]) → (∀ t, CountablyRectifiable n (RT.carrier ∩ {x | g x ≠ 0} ∩ f ⁻¹' {t})) → (∀ t, (∀ K : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → μHE[n] (RT.carrier ∩ {x | g x ≠ 0} ∩ f ⁻¹' {t} ∩ K) ≠ ∞) → ∀ᵐ x ∂(μHE[n].restrict (RT.carrier ∩ {x | g x ≠ 0} ∩ f ⁻¹' {t})), HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n (RT.carrier ∩ {x | g x ≠ 0} ∩ f ⁻¹' {t}) x (approxTangentPlane (n + 1) RT.carrier x ⊓ (ℝ ∙ g x)ᗮ)) → ∃ Rs : ℝ → IMRep U n, (∀ t, (Rs t).carrier ⊆ f ⁻¹' {t}) ∧ (∀ W : Set (Euclid P), MeasurableSet W → AEMeasurable (fun t => (Rs t).measure W) ∧ ∫⁻ t, (Rs t).measure W ≤ (L : ℝ≥0∞) * RT.measure W) ∧ (∀ ω : TestFormOn U n, Integrable (fun s => (Rs s).action (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n))) ∧ ∀ (ω : TestFormOn U n) (a b : ℝ), a < b → ∫ s in a..b, (Rs s).action (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n) = ∫ x in RT.carrier ∩ {x | a < f x ∧ f x < b}, (RT.mult x : ℝ) * RT.orient x (ContinuousAlternatingMap.alternatizeUncurryFin ((innerSL ℝ (g x)).smulRight ((ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n) x))) ∂μHE[n + 1]
